verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs say users describe a problem in plain language through the feedback widget. An intention then starts from that report, and its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention and proposes the tasks, after spam triage. Tasks then carry an approvable contract, which the CLI's `tasks ready` command filters on. Missing for 10: documentation of the structure and content of the proposed tasks, detail on how users review or edit the proposals, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
